faqs.threeAnswer: All course prices are displayed in Saudi riyals (SAR).
faqs.fourQuestion: Can I explore the lesson outline?
faqs.fourAnswer: Yes. Each course page includes its sections, lesson titles, and sample exam information.

About.title: Curiosity is a great beginning.
About.description: We believe useful knowledge should feel within reach. Alabbas Academy is a place to explore new ideas, build practical skills, and make learning a part of everyday life.
About.missionTitle: A little more knowledge. A little more possibility.
About.missionDescription: Our aim is simple: bring clear, practical learning closer to people across Saudi Arabia and beyond, in Arabic and English.
About.practicalDescription: Connect what you learn to something you can do, with examples and practice that make ideas tangible.
About.accessibleDescription: A clear, comfortable experience that gives you room to explore, whether you're starting out or building on what you know.
About.localDescription: An academy with Saudi roots, a bilingual experience, and a belief in the possibility of every learner.
About.ctaTitle: Your next chapter starts with curiosity.
About.ctaDescription: Find a topic that interests you and see where it takes you.

Account.storyTitle: Make room for what comes next.
Account.storyDescription: One account for your next steps at Alabbas Academy. Keep your details up to date and explore a new subject in your own time.
Account.storyOne: Explore courses in Arabic and English
Account.storyTwo: Manage your profile and account security
Account.storyThree: Follow your curiosity, at your own pace
Account.loginDescription: Sign in to your Alabbas Academy account.
Account.signupDescription: Create your account and confirm your email to get started.
Account.forgotDescription: Enter your email and we’ll send instructions to reset your password.
Account.resetDescription: Use a strong password that you don’t use on another website.
Account.verifyDescription: Confirm that this email address belongs to you.
Account.accountDescription: A little space for your profile, preferences, and account security.
Account.name: Full name
Account.passwordHint: Use 12–128 characters. A long, unique passphrase is a good choice.
Account.verificationRecoveryHint: Sign in to your account to request a new confirmation email. If your email is already confirmed, you can continue from your account.
Account.verificationHint: Check your inbox and spam folder. Open the email from Alabbas Academy, then confirm your email on the page it links to.
Account.confirmVerification: When you’re ready, press the button below to confirm your email.
Account.verificationDescription: Confirm your email to keep your account ready for learning and purchases.
Account.securityDescription: You’ll need your current password to change it. All active sessions will be signed out, including this one.
Account.learningDescription: Explore our sample course collection. Purchased lessons and your learning dashboard will be added in the next platform phases.
Account.googleDescription: Connect Google to this account after confirming your email and signing in with your password.
Account.googleLinkHint: For account security, sign in with your password within the last 10 minutes and use the same verified email in Google.

validation.name: Enter a name between 2 and 80 characters.
validation.password: Use a password between 12 and 128 characters.
validation.passwordDifferent: Choose a password different from your current password.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Please check the details you entered and try again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect. Please check them and try again.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You’ve tried several times. Please wait a little before trying again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Confirm your email and sign in again with your password before continuing.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Account services are unavailable. Please try again after the academy’s account setup is complete.
errors.OAuthAccountNotLinked: This email already belongs to an academy account. Sign in with your password first, then connect Google from your account page.
errors.AccessDenied: We couldn’t complete Google sign-in. Use a Google account with a verified email. To connect Google to an existing academy account, confirm your academy email, sign in with your password again, then connect the same email from your account page.

success.CHECK_EMAIL: Check your email for the confirmation instructions. If an account already exists, you can sign in or reset your password.
success.RESET_EMAIL_SENT: If an account matches that email, you’ll receive instructions to reset its password. Check your inbox and spam folder.
success.EMAIL_VERIFIED: Your email is confirmed. You’re ready to continue.
success.PASSWORD_RESET: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
success.PASSWORD_CHANGED: Your password has been changed. All sessions are signed out. Sign in again with your new password.
